The guide says the Move It law took effect ten years earlier without printing an effective date, so no date is taught; the traffic backup figure and the secondary crash share are the guide's own statements and were cited, not extended [A03].

Every coverage amount, bond amount, fee and period was kept exact; no legal interpretation was added.
